sections.content: Use *pero*, *sin* *embargo*, *aunque* and a *pesar* de *que* to acknowledge a different idea while maintaining your position. Aunque introduces a subordinate clause and can express concession before or after the main idea.

items.spanish: Estoy de acuerdo con la propuesta, pero creo que necesita algunos cambios.
items.english: I agree with the proposal, but I think it needs some changes.

items.spanish: La medida parece útil; sin embargo, podría ser difícil aplicarla.
items.english: The measure seems useful; however, it could be difficult to implement.

items.spanish: Aunque admito sus ventajas, no considero que sea la mejor opción.
items.english: Although I admit its advantages, I do not consider it the best option.

items.spanish: A pesar de que la idea es interesante, todavía falta evidencia.
items.english: Although the idea is interesting, there is still a lack of evidence.

sections.content: Concession does not mean abandoning your position. It lets you recognise another perspective before explaining your own.
